name: SCOUT Chicago weather, 6 July 2025
description: SCOUT's WRF-Chem 4.5.1 forecast of 2025-07-06 00:00 UTC over Chicago, the weather the scout.routing package reads: five NetCDF files, 49 hourly steps from 2025-07-06 00:00 to 2025-07-08 00:00 UTC on its 1 km Lambert conformal grid, cut to the 51 by 44 cells around SCOUT's Chicago road graph (latitude 41.59 to 42.07, longitude -88.02 to -87.46): RAIN.nc, hourly rain (RAIN); T2.nc, the temperature at 2 m (T2, in kelvin); RH2.nc, the relative humidity at 2 m (RH2, in percent); WSPD10.nc, the wind speed at 10 m (WSPD10, in metres per second); WDIR10.nc, the wind direction at 10 m (WDIR10, in degrees). Each file's global attribute timezone (America/Chicago) is the time zone the package reads a start time in. Read one with curio_load_data("data.scout.chicago-weather-2025-07-06", part="RAIN.nc"), or its path with curio_data_path("data.scout.chicago-weather-2025-07-06", part="RAIN.nc"). From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, backend/models/routing/weather_data/, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
